description: Returns a link that opens an EntryPing sign maker with the wording already filled in. The person can edit every line and print it free or save a PDF. Nothing is saved.

business.description: The business name to print on the sign.

head.description: The large main line, for example "Closed for Thanksgiving".

note.description: One sentence under the main lines, such as a phone number or where to leave deliveries.

slug.description: Which sign maker, from list_signs, for example "closed-for-thanksgiving".

style.description: Layout. Leave out to keep the sign's own.

sub.description: A short label before the time, for example "Open again".

time.description: A time or date, for example "Friday at 9".

name: make_sign_link
title: Make a sign link
